itemized.notes: Pages: 1 cover, 2 Summary Page, 3 the contributions attachment, 4 the expenditures attachment. Both attachments are typed spreadsheets, landscape but rendered upright by poppler (no rotation needed), each hand-annotated at the top 'Turner 4/5/06 County Council #3' and 'Schedule A pg 3/4' / 'Schedule B pg 4/4'. PRIVACY: the contributions attachment prints an Address column with every cell blank (the filer's omission, not a county redaction - there is no black bar); City and State were read from their own columns. The filer's own two-tier presentation is preserved: 13 named rows under 'Total Above $50', then a single printed aggregate 'Total Below $50' $335.00 which is emitted as a row with needs_review=1 (labelled field, not a named donor). Line 1 is the CANDIDATE'S OWN LOAN (Diane Turner, $153.23, 'Loan' in the Notes column) and is matched on the same day by the $153.23 County Clerk filing fee on Schedule B. 'Stationary' is the filer's spelling.
